title: Attention Is All You Need
abstract: A sequence transduction architecture based entirely on attention, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks

title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
abstract: A stable and lightweight method for aligning language models from human preferences without explicit reward modeling.
